intro_zh: 合肥是安徽省省会，临近巢湖，是三国故地与包公故里，近年崛起为重要的科技创新之城。
intro_en: Hefei, capital of Anhui, sits beside Chao Lake. A land of Three Kingdoms history and the hometown of the upright Judge Bao, it has risen in recent years as a hub of scientific innovation.
culture_zh: 包公的清廉故事在这里代代相传，科教与创新塑造着新合肥，李鸿章故居见证着近代风云。
culture_en: The tales of Judge Bao's integrity pass down through generations; science and innovation shape the new Hefei, while Li Hongzhang's residence recalls modern history.

attractions.desc_zh: 纪念清官包拯的园林，祠堂与墓园相连。
attractions.desc_en: A garden honoring the upright official Bao Zheng, with his shrine and tomb.

attractions.desc_zh: 水乡古镇，小桥流水，徽派民居。
attractions.desc_en: A water town of little bridges, streams and Huizhou-style houses.

attractions.desc_zh: 中国五大淡水湖之一，烟波浩渺。
attractions.desc_en: One of China's five great freshwater lakes, vast and misty.

foods.desc_zh: 多种食材烩成一锅，鲜香丰盛。
foods.desc_en: A hearty hotchpotch of many ingredients stewed together.

foods.desc_zh: 皮酥肉嫩的合肥风味烤鸭。
foods.desc_en: Hefei-style roast duck with crisp skin and tender meat.

foods.desc_zh: 米粉皮包馅油炸，金黄酥香。
foods.desc_en: Fried rice-flour dumplings, golden and crisp.
